changes: OpenClaw shipped stable v2026.5.22 on 2026-05-24 01:12 UTC, after v2026.5.22-beta.1 landed on 2026-05-23 09:59 UTC.
PicoClaw posted another nightly build on 2026-05-24 01:08 UTC, preserving the strongest day-to-day release cadence in the cheap-hardware and edge lane.
Hermes Agent, ZeroClaw, NanoClaw, IronClaw, HiClaw, and AstrBot all remained repo-active in the latest snapshot, but there was no taxonomy-changing entrant or positioning shift in the monitored set.
whyItMatters: The main signal today is OpenClaw shipping another stable, which reinforces its role as the category anchor and pace-setter.

PicoClaw keeps the low-cost always-on wedge visible, but the broader ecosystem shape still centers on lighter runtimes, safer runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, and learning-loop or long-running execution surfaces.
